objective: Repair the M468R2 baseline asymmetry and logical-only capacity gate, then evaluate exact on-demand PWP generation from sealed INT8 weights without reading the M40 one-shot payload. The schedule is sample, operator, output-row tile, then all 432 input partitions so the psum tile remains resident through operator commit.

paper_identity.runtime_population: M40 frozen S10 zurich_city_09_a exposed only through the M410R2 sealed original16 derivative
paper_identity.catalog_population: M73 disjoint DSEC train-only S32 over 18 sequences

schedule_contract.order: sample -> operator -> row_tile -> partition[0..431] -> operator/tile commit -> psum reset before next output-row tile
schedule_contract.exact_empty_gate: active-row bitmap is scanned before payload fetch; both strong-zero and every M430 candidate skip weight/PWP work for the same empty task
schedule_contract.psum_residency: all eight output blocks for one row tile remain resident across all 432 partitions and are committed once; intermediate off-chip psum spills are forbidden

block_bank_axis.8: One matcher/config/source traversal, then two four-block payload/replay halves; eight psum banks are resident.
block_bank_axis.4: Two complete 432-partition passes per row tile, one four-block half per pass. Source, active/config scan and matcher are repeated exactly twice. Weight/PWP bytes are the sum of the two distinct halves, not duplicated beyond their natural half payloads. Each half commits its own row-tile vectors, and only four psum banks are resident.

candidate_modes.stored_pwp: Fair M430 q32 baseline: fetch INT8 weights and only actually referenced PWP centers for each nonempty task.
candidate_modes.lazy_pwp: Fetch the same INT8 weights but no PWP payload. For each actually referenced center, form the exact signed PWP by summing the center-selected signed INT8 source-weight vectors.
candidate_modes.strong_zero: Exact zero-skip bit-sparse source issue using the same empty gate and the same INT8 weight fetch policy.

cycle_model.stored_eight_bank_overlap: After half0 DMA and replay, half1 DMA may overlap half0 replay exactly as M468R2; all exposed cycles and commands remain charged.
cycle_model.lazy_headline_schedule: Weight DMA, center generation and replay are serial; no generator/replay overlap is credited.
cycle_model.lazy_upper_bound_diagnostic: For eight banks only, additionally report a non-headline double-buffer diagnostic that overlaps half1 generation with half0 replay.

lazy_generator_contract.exact_value: For every output lane, sum signed INT8 weights for each set bit of the frozen 16-bit center; signed12 is sufficient because the absolute mathematical limit is 16*128=2048 and -2048..2032 is the realizable INT8 sum range.
lazy_generator_contract.reuse: A generated center is cached and reused by all descriptor rows within the same task/output half; no reuse is credited across partition, row tile, operator or sample.
lazy_generator_contract.port_schedule: One shared weight-vector read/PWP-buffer write generator. Generation is serialized with replay and therefore cannot be hidden. Generator weight reads, signed adds, cache writes and setup conflicts are counted.

resource_scaling.selection_policy: CPU cycle points only nominate a later same-library Synopsys throughput/area Pareto; K points must not be described as same-resource.

dse.macro_rounded_capacity_gate: conservative 144-bit slices with depth rounded upward to a 64-row quantum, plus valid/tag/active metadata, ping-pong source and descriptor buffers, FIFO and control reserve, total <= 240 KiB

capacity_contract.psum: 8 banks * row_tile * 96 lanes * signed19, with 96*19 widened to thirteen 144-bit physical slices per bank
capacity_contract.metadata: one active bit per output row, at least resident_block_banks*row_tile psum-valid bits (one per accumulator vector), and the actual row tags carried by each descriptor buffer; report each item separately
capacity_contract.source_descriptor: two source slots and two 48-bit descriptor slots
capacity_contract.payload: stored-PWP accounts two 4-block weight/PWP slots for eight banks and one sequential slot for four banks; headline serial lazy-PWP uses one four-block generated-center buffer reused between halves/passes, while the non-headline eight-bank overlap diagnostic separately reports the larger two-buffer capacity; strong-zero accounts resident task weights
capacity_contract.fixed_reserve_semantics: DMA FIFOs, command queues, matcher/generator queues, bitmap decoder state, control registers and arbitration reserve; logic area remains outside SRAM capacity

statistics: original16 popcount and modulo-8 maximum bank occupancy
M430 best residual popcount and modulo-8 maximum bank occupancy
exact route: EMPTY for popcount zero; popcount<=K is unconditionally DIRECT; otherwise choose PARENT only when parent cycle is strictly less than direct cycle, with ties routed DIRECT
g15_compact_sidecar.grain: sealed per-phase aggregates plus each row-tile DSE aggregate; no second derivative read

materiality_rule.vs_fair_same_tile_strong_zero: >= 1.15x at 128 B/cycle and both 240 KiB gates
materiality_rule.lazy_vs_fair_same_tile_stored_pwp: >= 1.10x at the same row tile, bandwidth and capacity accounting
materiality_rule.vs_original_m430: Report candidate_cycles / 517041352 only as a cross-bandwidth/full-resident diagnostic; never use it as a resource-normalized headline.
materiality_rule.admission: This CPU DSE cannot itself admit performance. A material point only nominates one implementation for independent hammer, RTL and Synopsys validation.

failure_policy: Strict JSON, exact-SHA inputs, no overwrite and preserve any failed output directory.
Do not read any M40 payload file or manifest beyond an identity string embedded in a sealed derivative/result.
Do not give the candidate an empty-task skip that the strong-zero baseline lacks.
Do not call logical fit a macro fit and do not hide macro rounding/control reserve.
Do not treat generation, weight reads, cache writes, commands or port conflicts as free.
